verdict.rationale: Docs show dispute-rate calculation on the Radar dashboard (stripe-radar-docs-7) and fraud-rate/volume trend visualizations (stripe-radar-docs-4), plus reviewable queues (stripe-radar-docs-11, docs-8) that imply review workload tracking. However there is no evidence of a false-positive-rate metric, approval-rate lift measurement, or any export/reporting feature for board consumption. missing for 10: false-positive rate metric, approval-rate lift metric, CSV/board export capability, independent confirmation of dashboard completeness.
